name: Resistor Environment Reasoning QA 12
description: This is a task to identify correct statements about circuit topology from resistance measurements between nodes.

examples.input:

- A to B: 56.667Ω
- A to X1: 6.667Ω
- A to N_b1: 11.667Ω
- A to N_b2: 21.667Ω
- A to N_b3: 36.667Ω
- B to N_b1: 45.0Ω
- B to N_b2: 35.0Ω
- B to N_b3: 20.0Ω
- B to X1: 50.0Ω
- X1 to N_b1: 5.0Ω
- N_b1 to N_b2: 10.0Ω
- N_b2 to N_b3: 15.0Ω
- N_b1 to N_b3: 25.0Ω
- N_b2 to X1: 15.0Ω
- N_b3 to X1: 30.0Ω

Assuming that all of the above measurements are accurate, which of the following statements is true?
